lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Hospitals and other health institutions in Toronto say their email services are returning to normal after a global Microsoft 365 outage caused some delays and disruptions, The Canadian Press reports.

Finland’s military said on Thursday its forces had detected “a strike” on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea a day earlier, but that the security situation in the area remained stable, The Canadian Press reports.
‘To be frank, I’m fed up’: Minister Joly slams Stellantis after meeting over plant sale, The Canadian Press reports.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department’s delay in implementing controls over the export of certain Nvidia chips to China, The Associated Press reports.

Police in Cape Breton say they’ve uncovered a major stolen vehicle trafficking ring following an investigation that began when a stolen vehicle was tracked to a property in, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
